topic_label: Commitment to integrity and ethical values
control_description: Group code of conduct and annual security acknowledgments; sanctions procedure (POL-01 4.7)
Board risk committee oversees cyber and AI risk each quarter; the Education Software division president reports division High risks
Education Software CISO reports to the Group CISO; COPPA program coordinator designated in writing (312.8(b)(1))
Background checks; annual awareness training; secure development and support training
Control owners named in the common control catalog and the division supplement; sanctions under POL-01 4.7
Automated cloud asset inventory; tenant and data store register for both platforms

topic_label: Internal communication of objectives and responsibilities
control_description: Group policies and the division supplement published and acknowledged each year
Service commitments in customer contracts; trust page; subprocessor list; security contact for customers
evidence: Contracts; trust page history; customer notices
gap: The 2026 system description omitted the AI tutor and its model provider although the tutor ran from 2026-01; no subprocessor notice to the 140 pilot districts; the trust page says staff access customer data only with permission, which standing support access contradicts (P03 ES-G16, ES-G17, ES-G18)
remediation: Subprocessor notices sent and trust page corrected; system description for the 2026-07-01 to 2027-06-30 period describes the tutor and the model provider as a subservice organization (POAM-014, POAM-001)

topic_label: Objectives specified to enable risk identification
control_description: Service commitments and risk tolerance set in POL-01 and the division register
Annual SP 800-30 risk analysis that also serves as the COPPA risk assessment (312.8(b)(2))
Insider misuse and credential abuse considered in the risk analysis (ES-001, ES-007)
Significant changes (new services, new subprocessors, acquisitions) to be assessed in the risk analysis
gap: The AI tutor launch (2026-01) was not assessed as a significant change before release (P03 ES-G04)
remediation: AI and children's privacy change gate in the division supplement (POAM-014)

control_description: Group internal audit assesses common controls each year and samples division controls; release-time tenant isolation tests
evidence: P07 assessment results; isolation test reports

control_description: Deficiencies tracked in the group POA&M and reported to the board risk committee

topic_label: Control activities selected to mitigate risk
control_description: Controls selected from the SP 800-53 baseline in the common control catalog and the platform control set
General IT controls through SYS-G1 to SYS-G3, carved in as internal shared services
evidence: Common control catalog; inheritance in the system description

topic_label: Control activities deployed through policies and procedures
control_description: Group policies plus the Education Software supplement
gap: Supplement v2025 lacks the AI and children's privacy change gate and the customer-approved support access rule required by POL-01 4.12 and POL-02 4.10
remediation: Re-issue the supplement with both rules (POAM-001, POAM-014)

topic_label: Logical access security software, infrastructure, architecture
control_description: SSO with MFA through SYS-G1; PAM with just-in-time elevation; tenant encryption keys; encryption at rest and in transit
Workforce accounts created and removed from HR events through identity governance
Role-based access with quarterly certification; support console roles
evidence: Certification results; support console role model; P07 AC-6 results
gap: 61 support accounts hold standing read access to every customer tenant, including the college and about 8 million children's records; 19 of 30 sampled reads had no customer approval (P07 AC-6, other than satisfied)
remediation: Ticket-bound, customer-approved, time-limited access through PAM; remove standing roles; monthly access summaries to customers (POAM-001)

control_description: Physical security inherited from cloud provider B (carved out)
Provider media sanitization; logical deletion of tenant stores and keys

topic_label: Protection against threats from outside boundaries
control_description: Hub firewalls, web application firewall, provider DDoS protection

topic_label: Restriction of data transmission and movement
control_description: TLS for all transmission, including calls to the model provider; data exports only through approved pipelines

topic_label: Prevention and detection of unauthorized or malicious software
control_description: EDR and workload protection; dependency scanning in the release pipeline

topic_label: Detection of configuration changes and vulnerabilities
control_description: Weekly vulnerability scans; guardrail drift reports; annual penetration test

topic_label: Monitoring for anomalies and security events
control_description: 24x7 group SOC monitoring of platform, identity, and console events
gap: No rule detects support console reads outside a ticket, and behavior analytics exclude service accounts (P07 SI-4)
remediation: Support console and service account detection rules (POAM-003)

control_description: Triage and severity rating by the SOC on one group scale
Group IR plan, P08 runbook, and customer notice within 72 hours under standard contracts
evidence: IR plan; P08 runbook and notification matrix
gap: About 1,300 district contracts carry state-specific notice terms with no register; the customer notice procedure has never been exercised across divisions (P03 ES-G15)
remediation: Contract term register feeding the P08 matrix; cross-division tabletop (POAM-024, POAM-004)

control_description: Recovery from immutable backups in the group vault; lessons learned within 30 days
Pull requests, peer review, automated tests, and release approval in the pipeline (SYS-E3)
gap: The AI tutor was approved for release without a privacy impact analysis or safety testing (P07 CM-4 and SA-11)
remediation: Change gate in the supplement; AI tutor test plan and red-team tests (POAM-014, POAM-013)

control_description: Continuity plans for both platforms; group cyber insurance

topic_label: Vendor and business partner risk management
control_description: Tiered vendor program; written assurances before partners receive children's data (312.8(c))
gap: Model provider not monitored after onboarding (ES-012); 23 of about 140 integration partners have no written security assurances (P03 ES-G08)
remediation: Annual model provider attestation and assurance report review; collect partner assurances or suspend integrations (POAM-024)

control_description: Capacity monitoring and autoscaling sized for registration and exam peaks
Multi-zone deployment with a warm standby region; immutable backups in the group vault; provider environmental controls
Annual regional failover test of both platforms

topic_label: Identification and maintenance of confidential information
control_description: Customer data classified Restricted (POL-04); tenant tags; zero-retention and no-training terms with the model provider
Customer data deleted 90 days after contract end, as the retention policy and contracts state
gap: Data of 212 former districts is still held, some more than 3 years after contract end (P03 ES-G09; P07 SI-12)
remediation: Delete and certify; automated deletion at contract end plus 90 days; monthly exception report (POAM-015)
